title: Task Contract
description: Structural requirements every Harbor task.toml must satisfy, derived by comparing hello-world (Harbor's built-in example) against discount-bug-fix (this project's first authored task).

schema_version.description: Both example tasks declared 1.4 — but see 'known_inconsistency' note below; matching versions did not guarantee matching shape.

known_inconsistency: Author info shape differs between example tasks: hello-world uses metadata.author_name/author_email; discount-bug-fix uses [[task.authors]] as an array of tables. Both claim schema_version 1.4. Not encoded as required here since it's not actually consistent in practice — worth resolving before writing a 3rd task, not before.
